relations.rationale: The PowerShell command was run as part of the initial exploit payload after exploiting Log4Shell.
The exploit payload then downloaded mdeploy.text after running the PowerShell command.
When executed, mde.ps1 downloaded file.zip and removed itself.
file.zip contained the XMRig cryptocurrency mining software and configuration files that were installed.
relations.epistemic_reason: 引句存在於原文，但沒有陳述先後或相依的字眼；此關係是依敘事順序推論，需人工確認。

relations.rationale: By exploiting Log4Shell, the actors gained access and created a Scheduled Task to execute RuntimeBroker.exe daily as SYSTEM.
After obtaining initial access and installing XMRig, the actors moved laterally using RDP and DefaultAccount.
Once established on the VDI-KMS host, the actors downloaded tools from transfer.sh.
The threat actors then executed Mimikatz on VDI-KMS to harvest credentials after downloading it.
After harvesting credentials with Mimikatz, the actors created a rogue domain administrator account.
relations.epistemic_reason: 引句存在於原文，但沒有陳述先後或相依的字眼；此關係是依敘事順序推論，需人工確認。

relations.rationale: Using the newly created rogue domain administrator account, the actors propagated via RDP to several hosts.
Upon logging into each host, the actors manually disabled Windows Defender via GUI.
After disabling Defender, the actors implanted Ngrok executables and configuration files on multiple hosts.
relations.epistemic_reason: 引句存在於原文，但沒有陳述先後或相依的字眼；此關係是依敘事順序推論，需人工確認。

relations.rationale: The actors proxied RDP sessions via Ngrok tunnels after implanting Ngrok executables.

relations.rationale: Once the actors moved laterally to the domain controller, they executed a PowerShell command to obtain a list of all machines.
